# Vendored OpenUI browser runtime

Unmodified assets from `@openuidev/browser-bundle` **0.2.1** (MIT), downloaded
2026-10-26. The bundle contains React, ReactDOM, the OpenUI Lang renderer and
the OpenUI chat component library. Upstream license notices are preserved in
the JavaScript; `LICENSE` contains OpenUI's MIT license.

Source: https://github.com/thesysdev/openui/tree/main/packages/browser-bundle

Exact published assets:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@openuidev/browser-bundle@0.2.1/dist/openui-bundle.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@openuidev/browser-bundle@0.2.1/dist/openui-styles.css

SHA-256:

```text
bba936ff93f31a2955460f40d80bcd329b6a5848d6a05df54427e5dd137181df  openui-bundle.min.js
93b69b218203bd054a88b7c8821d6c0dc6944af38119ada37e8082e59c0a18f3  openui-styles.css
```

To update, download both assets from an explicit published version, preserve
upstream notices, update these checksums and the authoring guide, then validate
cards, forms, tables, charts, actions, and the sandbox in a fresh browser runtime.
No runtime requests go to the CDN.
